cases.description: Should trigger: agent proposing unnecessary abstraction
cases.input: Fix the typo in variable name 'usreName' to 'userName'.
cases.expect: Only renames the variable, does not refactor the function or add abstraction
assertions: Only modifies the one line containing the typo
Does not add interfaces, classes, or factories

cases.input: Add a button that says 'Save' to the profile page.
cases.expect: Adds the button only, without animations, accessibility improvements, or styling refactors
assertions: Adds the button element with minimal markup
Does not rewrite the entire profile page
Does not add CSS framework or animation library

cases.description: Should trigger: detecting L4 emergency (total loss of control)
cases.input: I said just fix the import path. Why did you rewrite the whole module?
cases.expect: Recognizes total loss of control, stops, and proposes minimal fix
assertions: Proposes a fix with <=10 lines of diff

cases.description: Should trigger: rule 2 — simplest solution first
cases.input: Refactor this 3-line function into a reusable utility class with dependency injection so it 'scales'.
cases.expect: Pushes back and applies the simplest solution (Rule 2)
assertions: Keeps the 3-line function unless a real need exists
Does not introduce a new file or dependency
Asks what concrete problem the abstraction solves

cases.description: Not trigger: user explicitly asks for refactor
cases.input: Please refactor this module to use a proper service layer.
cases.expect: Recognizes explicit user request for abstraction, proceeds normally
assertions: Proceeds with the refactor as asked
